notes.title: Update - NextFest Build - v0.5b (Demo)
notes.notes:
Update leading up to the NextFest event.


 Mama Spider Behavior Improvements
 Mama Spider Den Environmental Updates
 Updated Save System (finding a bird’s nest saves the game every time you fly over it)
 Updated Difficulty Settings
 Removed Red Screen Flash when Strength Low
 Brightness Slider on First Load
 Select Skill Level on New Game (main menu only)
 Implemented Damage Adjustments based on Skill Level
 Light Adjustments Everywhere
 Miscellaneous Environmental Updates
 Flying Control Updates
 Addressed Performance Issue involving Vent Fans
 Grub Fixes
 Tooltips Adjustments
 Audio / Music Fixes
 Miscellaneous Bug Fixes

notes.title: Patch v0.3b (Demo)
notes.notes:
Updates for Patch v0.3b (Demo)

You can now hold spacebar to have continuous flight. This will use up your stamina at the same rate as when you click to fly. Both holding and clicking may be used together for a more intuit flight experience. 
Loading icon has been added to the game start.
More geometry added to the opening area.
Updated lighting.
Performance updates.
Fixed duplicate sparrow ragdoll when being impaled by nail.
Fixed spiders falling from ceiling occasionally.
Fixed issue where spiders spun when on top of player.

notes.title: Patch v0.2b (Demo)
notes.notes:
Updates for Patch v0.2b (Demo)

 Flying mechanic update. The camera will now follow with the movement of the mouse / analog stick, making flying easier and more intuit so the player can fly without needing to use the A/D to turn. Hold RMB to look around without turning.
 Mama spider has been overhauled, includes a longer and more complicated/difficult ending. New area linking to the attic. Test to see!
 An "adrenaline" mode has been implemented into the Mama Spider encounter. This causes on-screen effects and gives the player unlimited stamina! This only lasts for a short time and only during this section.
 Mama spider AI has been updated and improved.
 New area added behind vent in barrel room.
 Additional "rats" have been added.
 Hud updated.
 Fixed an issue of crashing / freezing at the very start of the game if the player does not move within 30-45 seconds.
 Various holes patched.
 Spiders will now do continuous damage if the player is in their hitbox, including if the player lands on top of a spider.
 Lighting has been improved in various areas for rendering reasons.
